name: RW08-B6 Microsoft 365 release pack
description: RW08-B6 (RW08 real-world test). Builds the release matrix (Excel), the sign-off (Word, also as PDF) and the release briefing (PowerPoint) for the 10 dossiers, stores them in the QA SharePoint site, links the Teams sign-off thread, checks the files are shared with the QA groups only, reads them back, reconciles the dossiers, checks for secrets and archives the evidence.

variables.name: result_file
